Generate the mean age of a geological subdivision

Source: R/geo_mid.R
geo_mid.Rd

Generates the mean age of a geological subdivision which is based on the Geological Time Scale

Usage

geo_mid(name = NULL)

Arguments

name

Name of the geochronological subdivision (character, exact and case-sensitive), e.g. an eon, era, period, epoch or stage such as "Silurian" or "Rhuddanian", as listed in column 1 of GTS_info (Geologic Time Scale 2020). The mean of the top and bottom age (Ma) of that unit is returned. Required (Default=NULL).

Value

Returns the mean age of the geochronological subdivision

References

Ogg, Gabi & Ogg, James & Gradstein, Felix. (2021). Recommended color coding of stages - Appendix 1 from Geologic Time Scale 2020.

Examples

#generate the Silurian part of the GTS
plot.new()
plot(
 x = c(0, 1),
 y = c(419.2, 443.8),
 col = "white",
 xlab = "",
 ylab = "Time (Ma)",
 xaxt = "n",
 xaxs = "i",
 yaxs = "i",
 ylim = rev(c(419, 444))
)            # Draw empty plot

polygon(
 x = c(0.66, 1, 1, 0.66),
 y = geo_loc("Rhuddanian"),
 col =geo_col("Rhuddanian")
)

text(
 0.85,geo_mid("Rhuddanian"),
 "Rhuddanian",
 cex = 1,
 col = "black",
 srt = 0
)
